The owner-absent case now retains a body-free intent and final file without markDirty; unsafe ingress fails before file publication. Owner rejection after publish retains the file. A bounded EPERM retry preserves final update bytes.

Source, HTTP, and bundle tool parity tests pass; the evidence records a rebuilt bundle without tracked drift. No product-main ledger write was added to the configured-store paths.
